name: com.gameframex.unity.download
description:
GameFrameX Download — Unity multi-agent download manager package. Handles concurrent file downloads with priority queuing and tag-based task management (remove by tag), a configurable agent pool (agent count, timeout, flush size) with pluggable agent helpers via Func factories, global pause, real-time speed reporting, Task-based completion waiting, and event-driven start / update / success / failure callbacks. Startup moves to code-level DownloadOptions (GameFrameXOptions.Configure). Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Download — Unity 多代理下载管理功能包。处理并发文件下载，支持优先级队列与基于 Tag 的任务管理（按 Tag 批量移除）、可配置代理池（代理数、超时、缓冲大小）与 Func 工厂可插拔代理辅助器、全局暂停、实时速度上报、Task 异步等待完成，以及开始/更新/成功/失败的事件回调。启动配置收敛为代码级 DownloadOptions（GameFrameXOptions.Configure）。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
